title: Ray Winstone Told Off a Director Who Was ‘Groping’ His Female Co-Star During Filming: ‘Don’t You Dare Do That’
description:
Ray Winstone recently recalled to The Times of London that he once told off an unnamed director after he saw them “groping” his female co-star.

	“I
body:
Ray Winstone recently recalled to The Times of London that he once told off an unnamed director after he saw them “groping” his female co-star.

	“I had this director once,” Winstone said. “I was in a scene where I had to pick up this girl, and the director wanted to show me what to do. But he was groping her. That was it. I said, ‘Don’t you dare do that.’ He abused his power, took advantage, and she was a good kid, you know, who seemed a little lost. Anyway, it was dealt with.”
	

	When asked in what matter the situation was “dealt with,” Winstone added, “Well, back in the day, if there was a wrong ’un on set, 99 times out of 100 it was sorted, either by the hairy-arse riggers or sparks. I’ve done it myself too, taken someone to the side to give them a slap or to tell them, in no uncertain terms, to behave. But it’s a different world today.”


	Winstone will soon star in Season 2 of “The Gentlemen,” which recently got the green light for its third season on Netflix. In the Guy Ritchie crime drama, Winstone plays kingpin Bobby Glass. Later in his sit-down with The Times, he said the role made him realize he is “getting old.”

	“When you’re not the young lead but the old boy, who everyone says they’ve got to look after because he’s getting on a bit,” Winstone said. The Times then asked if he had any plans to slow down his career, and Winstone quipped, “Well, you’ve got to pay the taxman, haven’t you?”

title: Box Office: ‘The Dog Stars’ Struggles With Just $3 Million on Friday; ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ to Win Weekend Again
description: 20th Century’s “The Dog Stars” and Keylight Pictures’ “Coyote vs. Acme” both debuted in theaters on Friday, but Sony and Marvel’s “Spider-Man: Brand
body:
20th Century’s “The Dog Stars” and Keylight Pictures’ “Coyote vs. Acme” both debuted in theaters on Friday, but Sony and Marvel’s “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” will once again win the weekend.

	“Coyote vs. Acme” fared best of the two major newcomers, landing in second place with an estimated $5.2 million domestically on Friday from 3,575 screens. The “Looney Tunes” live-action animation hybrid comedy should gross about $13.5 million by Sunday
	

	From director Dave Green, “Coyote vs. Acme” puts a twist on the classic Road Runner cartoons. After Acme products (think anvils and rocket skates) failed him one too many times, Wile E. Coyote takes the ubiquitous gadget manufacturer to court. Will Forte and Lana Condor star alongside John Cena, Tone Bell, Martha Kelly, Luis Guzmán, P.J. Byrne and John Early.


	“The Dog Stars” fell to No. 4 after earning just $3 million on Friday from 3,330 North American theaters. Rival estimates have the Ridley Scott action drama making $7.2 million through the weekend. 

	Jacob Elordi leads “The Dog Stars” as a lonely man with a canine companion living in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. When he discovers a mysterious transmission, he is determined to find its source. Other cast members include Margaret Qualley, Josh Brolin, Guy Pearce, Allison Janney and Benedict Wong.

	“Spider-Man: Brand New Day” is still leading the domestic box office through its fifth weekend in theaters. It added $5.5 million on Friday and should pull in $21 million by Sunday. That would notch the North American total for Sony-Marvel superhero epic to $890 million.
	

	Christopher Nolan’s “The Odyssey” continues to show out as it enters its seventh weekend, taking third with $3.7 million on Friday. By the end of the weekend, the sprawling historical drama should earn $14.6 million, pushing its domestic haul to $564 million.

	“Insidious: Out of the Further” made $2.9 million on Friday, slotting at No. 5. By the end of its sophomore weekend, it’s expected to make $9.32 million, which represents about a 60% drop from last week’s debut. $9.32 million would bring the horror sequel’s North American revenues to about $42.85 million.

title: ‘The Song of Scorpions,’ ‘Qissa’ Director Anup Singh Sets Mumbai Film ‘Lasya: The Gentle Dance’ (EXCLUSIVE)
description: Anup Singh, director of “Qissa” and “The Song of Scorpions,” is directing a new short film, “Lasya: The Gentle Dance,” shot on Mumbai’s streets, pro
body:
Anup Singh, director of “Qissa” and “The Song of Scorpions,” is directing a new short film, “Lasya: The Gentle Dance,” shot on Mumbai’s streets, produced by Mumbai-based Pretty Pictures.

	“The Gentle Dance” follows a father and son, beggars on Mumbai’s roadside, over the course of a day in their lives. Monsoon rains repeatedly destroy their shelter, and the city offers them little beyond hostility and indifference. It is the father’s stories about the boy’s late mother – her boldness and her refusal to let go of playfulness even as she navigated the city and the natural world – that allow the son to see himself as more than a victim, and give him the will to dance among the ruins as she did and rebuild his life.
	

	“This will be a short film,” Singh said. “It is for me an attempt, call it a desperate attempt, to see if in this time of AI, quick and violent action, and celebration of various demogogueries in storytelling, whether there is still a way to reaffirm cinema’s gentle ways of reaching us.”


	The film is produced by Pretty Pictures, the Mumbai-based banner helmed by Zeeshan Ahmad and Pretty Aggarwal.

	“Anup Singh’s work has always been about people on the margins,” Ahmad said. “His cinema has consistently insisted that their life not be documented only for the pain, but that the joys and the beauty of their life also be affirmed. We would like to support that vision in our work together.”

	Following the short, Pretty Pictures plans to begin work with Singh early next year on his next feature film, which would mark the third film he was set to make with Irrfan Khan. The project returns some six years after the actor’s death.
	

	“After this short, we are ready to start working with Anup Singh on his next feature film early next year,” Ahmad said. “Anup Singh is finally ready to return to the film. We are very excited to make this film in homage to Irrfan Khan.”

schema.headline: ‘The Song of Scorpions,’ ‘Qissa’ Director Anup Singh Sets Mumbai Film ‘Lasya: The Gentle Dance’ (EXCLUSIVE)

title: Shailene Woodley Was Crushed When She Found Out Her Scenes in ‘Amazing Spider-Man 2’ Were Cut: The Role of Mary Jane Was ‘My Dream’
description: More than 12 years later, Shailene Woodley has opened up about her disappointment in finding out that her part in “The Amazing Spider-Man 2” opposit
body:
More than 12 years later, Shailene Woodley has opened up about her disappointment in finding out that her part in “The Amazing Spider-Man 2” opposite Andrew Garfield didn’t make the final cut.

	Woodley, in a recent interview as part of the “SAG-AFTRA Foundation Conversations” series with actors about their craft, revealed that she found out a year after filming for “The Amazing Spider-Man 2” that she would not appear in the movie, which was released in theaters in May 2014.
	

	“That was a fun phone call,” Woodley recalled. 


	She said that being cast as Mary Jane Watson in the movie by director Marc Webb “was my dream because I really, oh my god, Spider-Man’s my favorite superhero. Mary Jane was my favorite character growing up. So, when I got it, I was like, ‘This is so exciting.’”

	Woodley said she filmed “like three scenes together, me and Andrew Garfield. And then like a year later, they were like, ‘So, you’re not in the movie anymore.’ And I was like, ‘What? What do you mean?’ And they were like, ‘We’ve introduced a lot of new characters in this last one, and we’re going to wait for… whatever happens between [Emma Stone’s character, Gwen Stacy, who is Peter Parker’s girlfriend in the film] and Andrew.” (Spoiler: Gwen Stacy dies in “The Amazing Spider-Man 2.”)

	Woodley said she was also told, “’Let’s wait for [Gwen Stacy] to die and then we’ll introduce Mary Jane.’ Which made sense. But then they didn’t make that film.”

	Apparently, the filmmakers decided to axe Mary Jane from the movie because they thought it was confusing to have the character as another love interest to Peter Parker. “Well, that’s what I was told, you know,” Woodley said. “But again, who knows what the truth is. I could have been terrible and they’re like, ‘We can’t do this.'”
	

	In 2014, at the New York premiere of “The Amazing Spider-Man 2” (which featured a Mary Jane-themed cocktail), producer Matt Tolmach told Variety this about the deletion of Woodley’s scenes: “We bit off more story than we could tell. We had a 148-page script. We were in the middle of that, and we realized this story [with Mary Jane] is not going to be in this movie.”

	In Sam Raimi’s Spider-Man movie trilogy, the role of Mary Jane was played by Kirsten Dunst opposite Tobey Maguire.

	In Woodley’s nearly 90-minute “SAG-AFTRA Foundation Conversations” interview, she also spoke about her performances in “Divergent,” “Dumb Money,” “The Descendants,” “The Fault in Our Stars,” HBO’s “Big Little Lies” and Season 2 of Hulu’s “Paradise.”

	You can watch the full interview here:

title: ‘New Girl’ Reunion Is Not Happening: ‘There Are No Scripts,’ Says Creator Liz Meriwether
description:
“New Girl” isn’t coming back anytime soon.

	Despite recent claims by Max Greenfield, who played Schmidt on the hit Fox sitcom, that he has read “am
body:
“New Girl” isn’t coming back anytime soon.

	Despite recent claims by Max Greenfield, who played Schmidt on the hit Fox sitcom, that he has read “amazing” scripts for a reunion, show creator Liz Meriwether insists, “There are no scripts.”

	I caught up with Meriwether at the Season 1 finale screening of her latest hit series “Furious” on Thursday night at the DGA in West Hollywood.


	“I don’t even have the scripts written for the things that I need to have scripts written for,” said Meriwether, who is adapting Britney Spears’s memoir “The Woman in Me” for a movie to be directed by Jon M. Chu and produce by Marc Platt.
	


	Greenfield set off speculation about a “New Girl” reunion in late July when he said during an appearance on “Today with Jenna & Sheinelle,” “As far as I know, it’s happening. I’ve seen scripts, they’re amazing.”

	Meriwether responded to Greenfield’s claim with a very tongue-in-cheek video on Instagram. “Max told everybody that there’s amazing scripts of a ‘New Girl’ reunion that I’ve written. Um — and just an update on that — the scripts were pretty good until everybody just started giving me notes on every little thing,” she cracked, before listing changes all of the stars of the show requested.

	For now, Meriwether told me, “I’ve honestly been enjoying this thing, whatever this is, that’s like this back and forth between the cast and me, and I think this is the show and I feel like maybe in the world of the internet…maybe the show is just this, these little videos, maybe that’s the reunion. I don’t know.”
	

	“New Girl” ran for seven seasons from 2011 to 2018.

	Greenfield eventually clarified his remarks exclusively with Variety, joking that he was confused because a reunion of sorts is happening. The cast, including Zooey Deschanel, Jake Johnson, Lamorne Morris, Hannah Simone and Damon Wayans Jr., will reunite at the Chrysalis Butterfly Ball in Los Angeles on Oct. 10 to receive the Rising Phoenix Award. Greenfield serves as host of the gala.

	The Rising Phoenix Award will recognize the series’ theme of starting over and people who make starting over possible.


	As for the Spears biopic, Meriwether said she can’t say much because it’s too early in the process: “It’s really interesting because I haven’t written a movie in a long time, so that’s been part of the process is just trying to think in a two-hour story as opposed to like an eight-hour story, which is what I’ve been used to doing.”

	She has yet to meet the “…Baby One More Time” hitmaker. “I would love to,” Meriwether said.




	

					Scoot McNairy, Emmy Rossum, Quincy Tyler Bernstine and Liz Meriwether at the “Furious” Los Angeles special screening at the DGA Theater on Aug. 27 in Los Angeles.
									Variety via Getty Images

schema.headline: ‘New Girl’ Reunion Is Not Happening: ‘There Are No Scripts,’ Says Creator Liz Meriwether

title: Anne Hathaway Joins Tom Cruise in ‘Days of Thunder’ Follow-Up; Paramount Sets Release Date (EXCLUSIVE)
description:
Anne Hathaway will star opposite Tom Cruise in the next chapter of “Days of Thunder,” Variety has learned exclusively.

	Paramount Pictures has date
body:
Anne Hathaway will star opposite Tom Cruise in the next chapter of “Days of Thunder,” Variety has learned exclusively.

	Paramount Pictures has dated the feature film sequel for June 2, 2028, when Cruise and Hathaway will hit the road almost 40 years after the original Tony Scott film was released. The project will be shot for IMAX screens, and released exclusively in theaters for formats including Dolby Cinema and 4DX. Cruise released a promotional image on Saturday celebrating Hathaway’s casting and posing with his co-lead on a NASCAR track. 
	

	Cruise will reprise his role as the scrappy driver Cole Trickle. Plot details are scarce, but Hathaway is set to play a racecar team owner and engineer. Jonathan Levine (“Long Shot,” “Mr. Irrelevant”) is confirmed to direct. Cruise is producing alongside Jerry Bruckheimer and Tommy Harper. 


	In the original, Cruise’s Trickle gets recruited to a new NASCAR team by a retired racing legend (Robert Duvall). The first film also starred Nicole Kidman, Randy Quaid and John C. Reilly.

	Hathaway has been on a tear in 2026, with four films in theaters including “Mother Mary,” “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” “The Odyssey” and “The End of Oak Street.” The expecting movie star will close out the year with the Coleen Hoover adaptation “Verity.” She’s just wrapped production on the Adam Driver military drama “Alone at Dawn,” and is working on a three-quel to her star-making Disney movie “The Princess Diaries.” Hathaway is represented by CAA, Entertainment 360 and Apex Public Relations.
	

	The ”Days of Thunder” follow-up is the first significant piece of IP that Cruise will engage with after ramping down the “Mission: Impossible” franchise. He’s also on the hook for another “Top Gun” movie, and will return to the prestige drama space with this year’s Alejandro González Iñárritu film “Digger.”

title: Kartik Aaryan’s ‘Captain India’ Sets September London Shoot (EXCLUSIVE)
description: “Captain India,” starring Kartik Aaryan, commences principal photography in London this September, with the shoot expected to wrap by the end of Oct
body:
“Captain India,” starring Kartik Aaryan, commences principal photography in London this September, with the shoot expected to wrap by the end of October.

	The film is directed by Shimit Amin, known for “Chak De! India,” a title that has continued to resonate with audiences years after its 2007 release. “Captain India” is produced by T-Series‘ Bhushan Kumar and Baweja Studios, alongside Dopamine Studios, with S.B. Films handling production.
	

	“Captain India” draws on India’s real-life evacuation of citizens from a war-torn country.  The screenplay is written by Nash Vazifdar, Sanchit Gupta and Priyadarshee Shrivastava. An ensemble cast is expected to join Aaryan.


	Aaryan most recently starred in “Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri” and “Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3,” and has “Naagzilla” and other projects currently in the pipeline. Amin, meanwhile, is best known for directing “Chak De! India” and “Rocket Singh: Salesman of the Year” (2009), both for Yash Raj Films, and has largely stayed away from feature directing in the years since. He directed an episode of BBC/Netflix’s “A Suitable Boy” (2020). 

	A film titled “Captain India” was first announced in 2021, with Hansal Mehta attached to direct for RSVP’s Ronnie Screwvala and Baweja Studios’ Harman Baweja, who also wrote that version of the script, and Aaryan set to play a pilot involved in the rescue mission. Principal photography was then expected to begin in early 2022. 

	The film is set for release on Aug. 13, 2027, timed to India’s Independence Day weekend.

	Production on “Captain India” begins Sept. 1.

title: 'Bachelor' Star Clayton Echard's Accuser Admits Fraud in Fake Twins Saga
description:
'Bachelor' Star Clayton Echard
                          Fake Twins Accuser Pleads Guilty
body:
'Bachelor' Star Clayton Echard
                          Fake Twins Accuser Pleads Guilty
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              August 29, 2026
                            12:09 PM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            Former "Bachelor" star Clayton Echard is finally getting some vindication ... because the woman who falsely claimed she was pregnant with his twins has pleaded guilty to fraud.
      
    
            Laura Owens pleaded guilty Friday to four felonies tied to fake pregnancy claims involving Echard and another man, according to The Arizona Republic.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            Owens admitted to two counts of fraudulent schemes and artifices, one count of perjury and one count of taking another person's identity.
      

            The saga began in 2023, when Owens claimed Echard got her pregnant with twins and filed a paternity case seeking child support.
      
    
            Clayton denied he was the father ... and Owens later said she'd suffered a miscarriage.
      
    
            But the case didn't end there ... a judge later found Owens repeatedly lied during the proceedings and referred the matter to prosecutors ... who accused her of fabricating evidence to back up her pregnancy claims.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            Prosecutors say Clayton wasn't her only alleged target ... claiming Owens made similar false pregnancy claims involving another man she dated in 2021.
      
    
            Owens was ultimately hit with 14 felony charges ... but under her plea deal, prosecutors agreed to dismiss the remaining 10.
      
    
            She could still wind up behind bars ... one fraud count leaves sentencing up to the judge, while the other three call for probation.
      
    
            Owens is scheduled to be sentenced October 23.

                          It's Bye-Bye U.S., Hello UK ...

                              August 29, 2026

            Milo Yiannopoulos is officially back in his home country of the United Kingdom ... after getting booted from the United States by ICE, TMZ has learned.
      
    
            Federal law enforcement sources tell TMZ ... Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents plucked Milo from a holding facility in Louisiana and transported him to an airport in another state so he could take a flight back to the UK.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Our sources say Kanye West's former exec was transported by ICE to the airport under federal authority. We're told ICE got confirmation from UK authorities that Milo's back on his home turf after he stepped off the plane.
      

            A spokesperson for the Department of Homeland Security confirmed that Milo was deported "back to his home country."
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            As TMZ first reported ... Milo was arrested by ICE agents when he walked off a plane at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport on Thursday night. He was then transferred to a holding facility in Alexandria, Louisiana for undocumented detainees awaiting deportation.
      
    
            A federal judge issued Milo a final removal order on July 22, 2026, after Milo remained in the U.S. beyond his authorized stay. Milo legally entered the states in 2019.

title: Dolly Parton: Tennessee Governor Proposes Plan To Rename Airport After Music Icon
description:
Dolly Parton
                          Nashville Airport To Be Renamed After Country Music Icon .
body:
Dolly Parton
                          Nashville Airport To Be Renamed After Country Music Icon ...
                          Governor Says
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              August 29, 2026
                            7:12 AM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Dolly Parton may be gone -- but her memory is going to live on forever at the Nashville International Airport, which is going to be renamed in honor of the country music icon, according to the Tennessee governor.
      
    
            Governor Bill Lee made the announcement Friday ... saying that his office and Nashville International Airport plan to rename the travel hub after Dolly after receiving an outpouring of public support for the measure.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            “Dolly Parton’s extraordinary life is forever woven into the fabric of our state,” Lee said, adding, “From her rural mountain home in East Tennessee to global stages, Dolly carried the Volunteer Spirit with her."
      
    
            Lee went on ... “At a place where Tennessee welcomes the world, it is fitting that Nashville International Airport would bear the name of our state’s favorite daughter and greet travelers with the enduring legacy of Dolly’s music, generosity, faith, and kindness.”
      
    
            Earlier this week ... the numbers on a Change.org petition to rename the airport after Dolly began to soar -- sitting at just 53K signatures before her death, it now has over 164K supporters.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            As you know, Dolly, a Tennessee native, died from cancer Tuesday at a hospital in Nashville. She was 80.
      
    
            Meanwhile, Lee has already gotten the ball rolling on the proposal by speaking to Dolly's team about it just this past week. He said her team was very appreciative for all the public support and is open to having discussions about the renaming.
      
    
            Dolly's still flying high even after her death.
